creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A healing beacon that mends my team while it stands
environmentalInteractions: Placement matters: a beacon behind cover survives longer; one in the open invites focused fire.
sideEffects: Healing only works inside its 7 m radius — anchoring to it concedes map control.
Enemy AI with high tactical intelligence will actively target the beacon.
counterplay: Destroy the beacon — 70 integrity falls quickly to focused or area fire.
Force the fight away from its radius and let it heal empty ground.
Burst damage outpaces its 3.2 vitality/second of healing.
visualManifestation: A crystalline pylon planted in the ground, pulsing rings of pale-green restorative light.
audioManifestation: A soft harmonic chime on every healing pulse.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: healing/protective object archetype.
